info.title: Pastell API
info.description:
Pastell is a web service used in public administrations. This document describes its REST API (version v2).

All requests are handled by a custom dispatcher (HttpApi) under `web/api/index.php`. URL rewriting maps `api_function=<path>` to the controller. Requests and responses are JSON encoded (`application/json`). POST responses use HTTP 201, DELETE may return 204.

Authentication is attempted in the following order:
1. `auth=cas` query parameter (CAS single sign-on)
2. Client certificate (mTLS) matching `utilisateur.certificat_verif_number`
3. Bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`, created via the user token endpoints)
4. HTTP Basic authentication (`Authorization: Basic ...`)

Failures return HTTP 401 with `WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="API Pastell"`. Brute-force attempts are rate limited to 5 per minute (HTTP 429 with `Retry-after: 60`).

Errors use the following shape, matching the HTTP status code:
```json
{ "status": "error", "error-message": "Description of the error" }
```

ID values are always returned as strings.
